title: Aye Ghuncha Dahan Bekas Dulha
body:
Aye ghuncha dahan bekas dulha
Aye seam badan bekas dulha
Mujrey ke liye aayi hae uttho
Naashaad dulhan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya se nayi yeh shaadi hai
Dono he taraf barbaadi hai
Shabbir ki beti bewah dulhan
Aur ibne Hassan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Hae khowf mujhe naaraaz na ho
Marzi hai tumhaari kya bolo
Mein haath mein ab kangna rakhoon
Ya rakhoon rasan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Humnaam hoon main bhi daadi ki
Hae tumko qasm is shaadi ki
Banwaado mujhe bhi ronay ko
Ek baithul hazan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh beqabri mujhsey Qasim
Chilthey hain mere paonchey Qasim
Khulwa doh ke uljhi jaati hae
Kangne mein rasan bekas dulha
